script_text: Pisces, Mercury Retrograde is hitting your seventh house this week, and it will shake every partnership you thought was solid forever. Monday through Wednesday, Venus trines Saturn in your first house, grounding your water element in real commitment, yet Mercury in the seventh delays contracts. Wednesday turns the tide as Pluto in your tenth house trines the Sun in your seventh, transforming career power dynamics overnight. By Thursday, the retrograde loosens its grip. Mars trine Neptune blesses your water element with practical stability, bringing partners and money back into balance for the whole weekend. Friday is your power day because Venus in the seventh house completes its trine to Saturn in your first house. Tuesday is your danger day because Mars squares Saturn in your first house today. Re-read every contract before signing, and also trust your intuition over emails completely. Follow for daily updates.
